editorial:
You meet two very different con artists who decide to compete for the same rich target. One is polished and classy, the other is scrappy and loud, and their clash gives the movie a playful energy. The story moves quickly through fancy hotels, awkward disguises, and silly traps, so you always feel like something funny is about to happen. It is not deep, but it is really easy to watch when you want a light comedy with a crime twist.

The best parts are the lead performances and the silly back-and-forth between them. Some jokes land better than others, and a few scenes feel rushed, but the movie keeps a very bright pace. If you enjoy harmless capers and female-led comedy, this is a very fun pick.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the two scammers team up to trick the tech prodigy, but he turns out to be smarter and richer than they expected. He reveals he knew about their plan and flips the con on them, taking their money instead. The twist shows that the supposed victim was actually the biggest hustler. They lose, he wins, and the movie ends with a playful reminder that nobody is safe from a good scam.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light comedies, female-led capers, and easy weekend movie nights.
